encroachment_definition: A pixel is classified as AGRICULTURAL ENCROACHMENT if it was agricultural (NDVI >= threshold, NDBI-dominant=False) in the baseline year AND is built-up (NDBI-dominant) in the comparison year. This is a satellite-derived change-detection proxy, not a legal/administrative determination of illegal encroachment.
calculation_method: Pixel-level AND of baseline-agricultural and comparison-built-up masks, summed through ee.Image.pixelArea() at native 10 m resolution.
caveats: Satellite-visible land-cover change consistent with encroachment is not a legal/administrative determination of illegal encroachment.
The agricultural baseline itself is a spectral proxy and should be validated against cadastral/agricultural authority data before legal action.
